name: a sequence diagram: submit a form

data.text:
@startuml
actor User
participant "Web app" as Web
participant API
database Database as DB
User -> Web : submit form
activate Web
Web -> API : POST /forms
activate API
API -> API : validate
alt valid
  API -> DB : insert
  DB --> API : row
  API --> Web : 201 created
else invalid
  API --> Web : 422 errors
end
deactivate API
Web --> User : confirmation, or the errors
deactivate Web
loop every minute
  Web -> API : GET /status
  API --> Web : status
end
note over User, Web : the form stays open until the status is final
User -> Web : close
Web -> API : DELETE /session
API --> Web : 204
Web --> User : signed out
@enduml
